summary: Visual QA sweep — Button contrast audit across Light and Dark themes on mobile (390x844) as admin (admin@fourbuy.co.za). Walked through Login, Public Valuation, Home, Submissions, Stock, Dealers, Profile, Vehicle detail (FB-000156, FB-000155). Toggled theme via Profile -> theme-toggle-light/dark. Screenshots captured for each screen in both themes. Result: 21 pass / 3 fail / 6 aesthetic. Key regressions found in LIGHT mode: the 'Sign Out' button on Profile has salmon text on very pale pink background (P1 low contrast); the FB-reference chip contrast is low; some ghost buttons in Stock/Dealers have very light borders on white cards. In DARK mode: 'Update Price' filled button visually blends into its parent dark card (icon+label are legible but the button silhouette disappears - aesthetic); delete/trash icon in the header uses red on a near-black surface with low contrast; 'Contact on WhatsApp' green ghost button contrast is fine, but 'Deal Done' outline chip has a barely-visible dark border. Natis Owners Query Pending amber chip verified in both themes and looks tasteful.

ui_bugs.issue: In LIGHT mode: pale salmon text on very pale pink background - label barely readable (P1). In DARK mode: dark red text on near-black card, low but acceptable contrast (P2).

ui_bugs.component: Vehicle detail > REFERENCE row chip (FB-000156 pill)
ui_bugs.issue: In LIGHT mode top of card: the 'FB-000156' pill on the right side of the REFERENCE row appears very low contrast (light gray on white). In DARK mode the same pill is readable. Visible in L_veh156_top_closeup vs D_veh156_top_closeup.

ui_bugs.component: Vehicle detail > Admin Pricing > Update Price primary button
ui_bugs.issue: In DARK mode the filled button uses black/near-black fill on a near-black card - the button outline disappears entirely into the card. Only the white icon+label are visible. Looks like floating text. Aesthetic/P2.

ui_bugs.component: Vehicle detail header > Trash / delete icon (top-right)
ui_bugs.issue: In DARK mode the trash icon is drawn in red on a near-black surface, low contrast; combined with no explicit hit-target background, it is easy to miss. P2. In LIGHT mode it's a clearer red on white - fine.

ui_bugs.component: Stock list > 'Open' ghost button on each row
ui_bugs.issue: In LIGHT mode the outline is a very pale gray on white card - button edges nearly invisible. Label is still readable so P2. 'Mark Sold' primary button next to it is fine (black fill).

In LIGHT mode both header buttons render as white/near-white pills with a thin gray outline on a white background - very subtle. Label text is dark and readable so this is aesthetic (P2). In DARK mode the same buttons show fine.

ui_bugs.component: Vehicle detail > Deal outcome tri-state chips (Pending / Deal Done / No Deal)
ui_bugs.issue: In DARK mode 'Deal Done' and 'No Deal' inactive outline chips use a very dark outline on the dark card; the outlines nearly disappear and the chips look like plain text. Icons are legible so P2 aesthetic. Amber 'Pending' active chip is fine in both themes.
In LIGHT mode the pill uses light gray fill with mid-gray text on a white card - low contrast but readable. P2 aesthetic.
Portal is dark-themed only; 'Continue' button is white with dark label, readable. Toggle does not apply here (public page). Reported as OK but note there is no light-mode variant.

issues: Sign Out button uses tinted-red text on tinted-red background (approx #FEE2E2 bg / #F87171 text) - fails WCAG AA.
FB reference pill contrast is poor.
'LOCKED AT VALUATION' pill grey-on-white is subtle.
Primary filled buttons (Update Price) blend into dark card - consider adding a subtle border or lifting the button surface.
Inactive outline chips use near-invisible borders.
Ghost/outline header buttons need a slightly darker border to be discoverable on white cards.

action_items: Fix Sign Out (logout-button) in LIGHT mode - increase text contrast (e.g. use #B91C1C or #991B1B text on #FEE2E2 bg, or use outlined red border with darker label).
Increase contrast of FB-reference chip on vehicle detail in LIGHT mode (use darker text on the pill).
In DARK mode add a subtle border or 1-2 shade lift to the 'Update Price' primary button so its silhouette is visible against the card.
Review inactive Deal Outcome outline chips in DARK mode - increase border alpha or lighten the outline color.
In LIGHT mode strengthen the outline color on Stock 'Open' and Dealers header ghost buttons for discoverability.
In DARK mode consider giving the header trash icon a slightly larger tap-target background or a lighter red so it's easier to spot.
critical_code_review_comments: Not applicable for a visual audit - no code changes made.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing FB-000156 (Mercedes AMG C43) and FB-000155 (VW Tiguan) submissions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vehicle IDs used: FB-000156=38b860ee-fb00-4784-a7a0-987031de2325, FB-000155=a18787ac-b4ea-41f6-ae03-90bc41322559. Toggle theme via Profile tab (testIDs theme-toggle-light / theme-toggle-dark). The Natis Owners Query Pending amber chip renders on FB-000156's Kredo CarTrust Vehicle Report row inside VIN-Linked Reports section - verified readable in both themes.
rca_of_issue: Root cause for Light-mode Sign Out button contrast: destructive/danger button uses low-alpha tinted red for both bg and label in the light palette. Root cause for Dark-mode Update Price button: primary variant uses colors.card as fill on dark surfaces so it collapses into the parent card. Both are token-level fixes in the theme file, not per-screen fixes.
